nodes.description: Caller controlled address used throughout deposits, withdrawals, staking, reward claims and ownership transfers.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for distribution aggregation, vesting epochs and stake lock checks (now).
Ownable stored owner address governing privileged functions.
Module stored Pool contract address used as target of delegated module lookups.
PoolToken flag that can freeze user-to-user transfers.
DistributionToken accumulated tokens awaiting a distribution.
DistributionToken timestamp controlling when the next distribution may fire.
DistributionToken array of distribution records used in claim math.
RewardDistributionModule array of reward distributions.
SavingsModule list of DeFi protocols iterated by distributeYield.
SavingsModule mapping protocol address to ProtocolInfo (poolToken, balances, caps).
RewardDistributionModule mapping user to reward balances/shares.
StakingPoolBase mapping address to stake contract data.
StakingPoolBase running total of staked tokens.
StakingPoolBase per-user remaining staking cap.
SafeMath.add checked unsigned addition.
SafeMath.sub checked unsigned subtraction.
SafeMath.mul checked unsigned multiplication.
SafeMath.div checked division by zero.
SafeMath.mod checked modulo.
Module.getModuleAddress performs a staticcall to the Pool to resolve a module address.
DistributionToken._create_distribution mints distribution and resets accumulator using now.
DistributionToken math loop multiplying balance by distribution amounts.
PoolToken._transfer enforces allowTransfers and notifies reward module.
PoolToken.burnFrom skips allowance when caller is minter.
SavingsModule.deposit mints pool tokens for caller after depositing to protocol with caps and fees.
SavingsModule.depositToProtocol pulls tokens and calls protocol.handleDeposit.
SavingsModule.withdraw pulls tokens out of protocol and burns pool tokens.
SavingsModule.withdrawAll withdraws proportionally with slippage check.
SavingsModule.distributeYieldInternal computes protocol balance delta and triggers distributions.
SavingsModule.updateProtocolBalance refreshes stored protocol balance after external ops.
RewardVestingModule._claimRewards computes vested amounts using block.timestamp and transfers.
RewardVestingModule._addReward creates/updates vesting epochs and pulls reward tokens.
RewardVestingModule.createEpoch appends epoch and adds reward.
StakingPoolBase.createStake pulls tokens and records a locked stake timestamped with block.timestamp.
StakingPoolBase.withdrawStake transfers staked tokens back before updating stake records.
StakingPoolBase.unstakeAllUnlocked loops over stakes comparing unlockedTimestamp to block.timestamp.
StakingPool._withdrawRewards zeroes stored rewards and transfers tokens to the user.
RewardDistributionModule._updateRewardBalance accumulates user rewards across distributions.
RewardDistributionModule.distributeReward claims protocol rewards and records a distribution.
RewardDistributionModule._withdrawReward zeroes balance and calls protocol.withdrawReward.
Ownable.transferOwnership changes owner address guarded by onlyOwner.
DistributionToken.claimDistributions creates distribution if ready and updates user balance.
Address.sendValue performs recipient.call.value(amount) low-level value transfer.
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn performs address(token).call(data) with optional return decoding.
Module does pool.staticcall for module address resolution.
External call IDefiProtocol.handleDeposit after token transfer.
External call IDefiProtocol.withdraw transferring tokens to beneficiary.
IERC20.safeTransfer external token transfer in vesting claim.
stakingToken.transfer / transferFrom external ERC20 calls in StakingPoolBase.
External call rewardVesting.claimRewards() from StakingPool.
External call protocol.withdrawReward paying rewards to user.
PoolToken.userBalanceChanged calls reward distribution module back during transfers.
Parameter a of SafeMath.add.
Parameter data of SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn (encoded call payload).
Parameter _dnAmounts of SavingsModule.deposit (denormalized amounts).
Parameter maxNAmount of SavingsModule.withdraw bounding burned pool tokens.
Parameter token of RewardVestingModule._claimRewards.
Parameter epoch of RewardVestingModule._addReward.
Parameter _amount of StakingPoolBase.createStake.
Parameter user of RewardDistributionModule._updateRewardBalance.
Local c holding a+b inside SafeMath.add.
Local success flag of the raw call in Address.sendValue.
Local currentBalance of SavingsModule.distributeYieldInternal.
Local claimAmount accumulated in RewardVestingModule._claimRewards.
Local reward accumulator used in RewardDistributionModule reward balance math.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used for deposit caps, allowance checks and minting of pool tokens.
msg.sender is the withdraw beneficiary and the account whose pool tokens are burned.
msg.sender controls withdrawAll beneficiary and burn amount.
Transfer sender derived from msg.sender drives allowTransfers restriction.
msg.sender is the staker pulled from and the stake owner.
msg.sender is the recipient of unstaked tokens.
msg.sender dictates which stake list is iterated for unstaking.
msg.sender resolves the user whose reward balance is updated.
_msgSender is used as protocol address when claiming vesting rewards.
_msgSender is the payer of reward tokens via safeTransferFrom.
msg.sender is the recipient of withdrawn rewards.
Only the current msg.sender owner can transfer ownership.
Claim distributions can be executed for arbitrary accounts by msg.sender.
Tokens are pulled from msg.sender into the protocol during deposit.
Distribution creation depends on now to compute nextDistributionTimestamp.
Vested reward amounts depend on block.timestamp comparisons and interpolation.
Stake unlock timestamps are computed from block.timestamp plus lock duration.
Withdraw validity depends on block.timestamp versus unlockedTimestamp.
Iteration checks unlockedTimestamp <= block.timestamp.
Epoch creation/extension compares epoch end with block.timestamp.
Stored pool address is the staticcall target for module resolution.
ProtocolInfo (poolToken, caps) drives deposit minting and cap checks.
ProtocolInfo supplies poolToken and slippage values during withdraw.
previousBalance and poolToken of ProtocolInfo are read to compute yield.
User reward balances/shares are accumulated across distributions.
Stored reward balance is zeroed and paid out.
stakeHolders entry is read and mutated while withdrawing a stake.
totalStakedAmount is increased as stakes are created.
distributionAccumulator is consumed and reset when creating a distribution.
nextDistributionTimestamp is recomputed inside distribution creation.
allowTransfers flag gates user-to-user transfers.
_owner gate restricts ownership transfer to the owner.
Distributions array is iterated in the claim amount calculation.
deposit calls depositToProtocol to move funds into the DeFi protocol.
deposit calls distributeYieldInternal before depositing.
deposit calls updateProtocolBalance after depositing.
withdraw calls distributeYieldInternal before withdrawing.
withdraw calls updateProtocolBalance after withdrawing.
withdrawAll calls distributeYieldInternal.
withdrawAll calls updateProtocolBalance.
depositToProtocol invokes protocol.handleDeposit externally.
withdraw invokes protocol.withdraw externally.
withdrawAll invokes protocol.withdraw externally.
Claiming vesting rewards performs an external safeTransfer to the protocol.
Withdrawing staking rewards transfers the ERC20 reward token.
_withdrawReward calls protocol.withdrawReward externally.
createStake pulls tokens via stakingToken.transferFrom.
withdrawStake sends tokens back via stakingToken.transfer.
createEpoch delegates to _addReward.
PoolToken._transfer notifies the reward module on every balance change.
Reward distribution pulls protocol rewards via claimRewards flow.
StakingPool collects vesting rewards through an external claimRewards call.
External handleDeposit call occurs before protocol balance is refreshed, allowing a malicious protocol to reenter deposit logic.
External protocol.withdraw happens before updateProtocolBalance, enabling reentrancy into withdraw accounting.
stakingToken.transfer is performed before stake bookkeeping is updated in withdrawStake.
userBalanceChanged performs an external callback during token transfer, a reentrancy vector if the module misbehaves.
Parameter a feeds the checked addition.
Encoded data parameter is the payload of the low-level token call.
Denormalized amounts are summed and compared with the resulting deposit amount.
maxNAmount bounds the computed burned pool token amount.
Reward token parameter selects which IERC20 is transferred.
Epoch parameter selects which vesting epoch amount is incremented.
Stake amount is added to totals and stored in the stake record.
User parameter selects the reward balance entry being updated.
Local c holds the raw a+b result checked against a.
Success flag is the result of the raw value call.
currentBalance is compared to the stored previous balance to detect yield.
claimAmount accumulates proportional epoch rewards computed with mul/div.
reward accumulator sums proportional reward shares before payout.

normalization_plan.reason: Function argument a only has meaning as an operand of SafeMath.add.
Encoded call data is consumed only by the low-level token call.
Amount array parameter is used exclusively by the deposit flow.
Bounding parameter is only checked inside withdraw.
Reward token parameter selects the token transferred in _claimRewards.
Epoch index parameter selects the vesting epoch mutated by _addReward.
Stake amount parameter is stored and added to totals in createStake.
User parameter selects the reward balance state entry updated.
Local c is the checked result of the addition.
Success local captures the outcome of the low-level value call.
Local currentBalance is the protocol balance snapshot used by the yield logic.
Local claimAmount accumulates the vesting payout inside the claim loop.
Local reward accumulator feeds the reward withdrawal amount.
